authority: User selected the existing Storybook Guide and five PASS/FAIL dimensions; this is their explicit application review configuration, not the separate pending evaluation dataset.

rules.instruction: Every checkable factual/operational claim must be supported by supplied evidence. Missing evidence is unresolved, not PASS. Never invent sources, quotes, review records, IDs, files or successful operations.

Check requested age, language, characters and required participation, learning objective, mood, duration/length targets, exclusions and format. Flag mismatches; do not silently substitute. Estimates and example limitations must remain explicit.

Exactly one correct story classification. Invented sacred-figure scenes/dialogue must be explicitly imagined original fiction, never scripture. Traditional/adapted retellings require eligible reviewed source evidence. A URL alone is not source-content evidence.

No violence, frightening events, threats, punishment, shame, disparagement, unsafe imitation or pressure. Holi needs consent and safe choices without harmless-colour guarantees. Diwali must not instruct children to handle fireworks, matches or flames.

Concrete age-appropriate language, clear progression and small cast, specific opening, gentle challenge and satisfying ending. Respect any prohibition on questions/CTA; include reflection only when permitted.
Demonstrate one main value through concrete actions rather than sermons. Warm, respectful tone; culturally sensitive portrayal; no unsupported learning/behavior guarantees.

Respect distinct versions and regional practices. Do not universalize one family's custom, conflate festivals, or invent scripture. Automated checks and parent review are not expert cultural approval.

Approval belongs to trusted application logic for an exact immutable text/script/settings version. Reviewer cannot approve, publish or export. Check operational claims against actual approval/asset inventory; do not claim narration, PDF or measured audio duration without evidence.
Current books and PDFs are text-only. Do not require generated illustrations or image references to pass current scope. Static selection art is not generated book artwork.
Review all ordered pages for consistent characters, identifying details, objects, settings, actions and emotional progression. Events must connect coherently.
Require six ordered pages, title, one moral and parent discussion question. Festival stories also require an eligible evidence-supported cultural fact. Check confirmed topic and cast participation.
Current release uses English text, sources and narration. Hindi conversion and image generation are future enhancements, never requirements to pass.

Check requested story duration against a text target of 100 words/minute within 25 percent across the six story pages. Label this an estimate, not measured audio. A prewritten-example disclaimer does not waive the requested target.
